values_json: {"Description": "Personal traits and abilities that affect how people learn and perform at work.", "Element ID": "1", "Element Name": "Worker Characteristics"}
{"Description": "Natural talents and capabilities that affect how well someone can perform work.", "Element ID": "1.A", "Element Name": "Abilities"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence the acquisition and application of knowledge in problem solving", "Element ID": "1.A.1", "Element Name": "Cognitive Abilities"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence the acquisition and application of verbal information in problem solving", "Element ID": "1.A.1.a", "Element Name": "Verbal Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.a.1", "Element Name": "Oral Comprehension"}
{"Description": "The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.a.2", "Element Name": "Written Comprehension"}
{"Description": "The ability to communicate information and ideas in speaking so others will understand.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.a.3", "Element Name": "Oral Expression"}
{"Description": "The ability to communicate information and ideas in writing so others will understand.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.a.4", "Element Name": "Written Expression"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence the application and manipulation of information in problem solving", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b", "Element Name": "Idea Generation and Reasoning Abilities"}

{"Description": "The ability to come up with a number of ideas about a topic (the number of ideas is important, not their quality, correctness, or creativity).", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.1", "Element Name": "Fluency of Ideas"}

{"Description": "The ability to come up with unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.2", "Element Name": "Originality"}

{"Description": "The ability to tell when something is wrong or is likely to go wrong. It does not involve solving the problem, only recognizing that there is a problem.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.3", "Element Name": "Problem Sensitivity"}
{"Description": "The ability to apply general rules to specific problems to produce answers that make sense.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.4", "Element Name": "Deductive Reasoning"}

{"Description": "The ability to combine pieces of information to form general rules or conclusions (includes finding a relationship among seemingly unrelated events).", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.5", "Element Name": "Inductive Reasoning"}

{"Description": "The ability to arrange things or actions in a certain order or pattern according to a specific rule or set of rules (e.g., patterns of numbers, letters, words, pictures, mathematical operations).", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.6", "Element Name": "Information Ordering"}
{"Description": "The ability to generate or use different sets of rules for combining or grouping things in different ways.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.b.7", "Element Name": "Category Flexibility"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence the solution of problems involving mathematical relationships", "Element ID": "1.A.1.c", "Element Name": "Quantitative Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to choose the right mathematical methods or formulas to solve a problem.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.c.1", "Element Name": "Mathematical Reasoning"}
{"Description": "The ability to add, subtract, multiply, or divide quickly and correctly.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.c.2", "Element Name": "Number Facility"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the recall of available information", "Element ID": "1.A.1.d", "Element Name": "Memory"}
{"Description": "The ability to remember information such as words, numbers, pictures, and procedures.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.d.1", "Element Name": "Memorization"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the acquisition and organization of visual information", "Element ID": "1.A.1.e", "Element Name": "Perceptual Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to quickly make sense of, combine, and organize information into meaningful patterns.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.e.1", "Element Name": "Speed of Closure"}

{"Description": "The ability to identify or detect a known pattern (a figure, object, word, or sound) that is hidden in other distracting material.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.e.2", "Element Name": "Flexibility of Closure"}

{"Description": "The ability to quickly and accurately compare similarities and differences among sets of letters, numbers, objects, pictures, or patterns. The things to be compared may be presented at the same time or one after the other. This ability also includes comparing a presented object with a remembered object.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.e.3", "Element Name": "Perceptual Speed"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the manipulation and organization of spatial information", "Element ID": "1.A.1.f", "Element Name": "Spatial Abilities"}

{"Description": "The ability to know your location in relation to the environment or to know where other objects are in relation to you.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.f.1", "Element Name": "Spatial Orientation"}
{"Description": "The ability to imagine how something will look after it is moved around or when its parts are moved or rearranged.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.f.2", "Element Name": "Visualization"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to application of attention", "Element ID": "1.A.1.g", "Element Name": "Attentiveness"}
{"Description": "The ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time without being distracted.", "Element ID": "1.A.1.g.1", "Element Name": "Selective Attention"}

{"Description": "The ability to shift back and forth between two or more activities or sources of information (such as speech, sounds, touch, or other sources).", "Element ID": "1.A.1.g.2", "Element Name": "Time Sharing"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence the capacity to manipulate and control objects", "Element ID": "1.A.2", "Element Name": "Psychomotor Abilities"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the manipulation of objects", "Element ID": "1.A.2.a", "Element Name": "Fine Manipulative Abilities"}

{"Description": "The ability to keep your hand and arm steady while moving your arm or while holding your arm and hand in one position.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.a.1", "Element Name": "Arm-Hand Steadiness"}

{"Description": "The ability to quickly move your hand, your hand together with your arm, or your two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.a.2", "Element Name": "Manual Dexterity"}

{"Description": "The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.a.3", "Element Name": "Finger Dexterity"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the control and manipulation of objects in time and space", "Element ID": "1.A.2.b", "Element Name": "Control Movement Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to quickly and repeatedly adjust the controls of a machine or a vehicle to exact positions.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.b.1", "Element Name": "Control Precision"}

{"Description": "The ability to coordinate two or more limbs (for example, two arms, two legs, or one leg and one arm) while sitting, standing, or lying down. It does not involve performing the activities while the whole body is in motion.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.b.2", "Element Name": "Multilimb Coordination"}

{"Description": "The ability to choose quickly between two or more movements in response to two or more different signals (lights, sounds, pictures). It includes the speed with which the correct response is started with the hand, foot, or other body part.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.b.3", "Element Name": "Response Orientation"}

{"Description": "The ability to time your movements or the movement of a piece of equipment in anticipation of changes in the speed and/or direction of a moving object or scene.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.b.4", "Element Name": "Rate Control"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to speed of manipulation of objects", "Element ID": "1.A.2.c", "Element Name": "Reaction Time and Speed Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to quickly respond (with the hand, finger, or foot) to a signal (sound, light, picture) when it appears.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.c.1", "Element Name": "Reaction Time"}
{"Description": "The ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.c.2", "Element Name": "Wrist-Finger Speed"}
{"Description": "The ability to quickly move the arms and legs.", "Element ID": "1.A.2.c.3", "Element Name": "Speed of Limb Movement"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence strength, endurance, flexibility, balance and coordination", "Element ID": "1.A.3", "Element Name": "Physical Abilities"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the capacity to exert force", "Element ID": "1.A.3.a", "Element Name": "Physical Strength Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to exert maximum muscle force to lift, push, pull, or carry objects.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.a.1", "Element Name": "Static Strength"}

{"Description": "The ability to use short bursts of muscle force to propel oneself (as in jumping or sprinting), or to throw an object.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.a.2", "Element Name": "Explosive Strength"}

{"Description": "The ability to exert muscle force repeatedly or continuously over time. This involves muscular endurance and resistance to muscle fatigue.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.a.3", "Element Name": "Dynamic Strength"}

{"Description": "The ability to use your abdominal and lower back muscles to support part of the body repeatedly or continuously over time without \"giving out\" or fatiguing.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.a.4", "Element Name": "Trunk Strength"}
{"Description": "The ability to exert oneself physically over long periods without getting out of breath", "Element ID": "1.A.3.b", "Element Name": "Endurance"}
{"Description": "The ability to exert yourself physically over long periods of time without getting winded or out of breath.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.b.1", "Element Name": "Stamina"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to the control of gross body movements", "Element ID": "1.A.3.c", "Element Name": "Flexibility, Balance, and Coordination"}
{"Description": "The ability to bend, stretch, twist, or reach with your body, arms, and/or legs.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.c.1", "Element Name": "Extent Flexibility"}
{"Description": "The ability to quickly and repeatedly bend, stretch, twist, or reach out with your body, arms, and/or legs.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.c.2", "Element Name": "Dynamic Flexibility"}

{"Description": "The ability to coordinate the movement of your arms, legs, and torso together when the whole body is in motion.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.c.3", "Element Name": "Gross Body Coordination"}
{"Description": "The ability to keep or regain your body balance or stay upright when in an unstable position.", "Element ID": "1.A.3.c.4", "Element Name": "Gross Body Equilibrium"}
{"Description": "Abilities that influence visual, auditory and speech perception", "Element ID": "1.A.4", "Element Name": "Sensory Abilities"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to visual sensory input", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a", "Element Name": "Visual Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to see details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.1", "Element Name": "Near Vision"}
{"Description": "The ability to see details at a distance.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.2", "Element Name": "Far Vision"}
{"Description": "The ability to match or detect differences between colors, including shades of color and brightness.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.3", "Element Name": "Visual Color Discrimination"}
{"Description": "The ability to see under low-light conditions.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.4", "Element Name": "Night Vision"}
{"Description": "The ability to see objects or movement of objects to one's side when the eyes are looking ahead.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.5", "Element Name": "Peripheral Vision"}

{"Description": "The ability to judge which of several objects is closer or farther away from you, or to judge the distance between you and an object.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.6", "Element Name": "Depth Perception"}
{"Description": "The ability to see objects in the presence of a glare or bright lighting.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.a.7", "Element Name": "Glare Sensitivity"}
{"Description": "Abilities related to auditory and oral input", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b", "Element Name": "Auditory and Speech Abilities"}
{"Description": "The ability to detect or tell the differences between sounds that vary in pitch and loudness.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b.1", "Element Name": "Hearing Sensitivity"}
{"Description": "The ability to focus on a single source of sound in the presence of other distracting sounds.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b.2", "Element Name": "Auditory Attention"}
{"Description": "The ability to tell the direction from which a sound originated.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b.3", "Element Name": "Sound Localization"}
{"Description": "The ability to identify and understand the speech of another person.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b.4", "Element Name": "Speech Recognition"}
{"Description": "The ability to speak clearly so others can understand you.", "Element ID": "1.A.4.b.5", "Element Name": "Speech Clarity"}
{"Description": "Work types and activities you enjoy.", "Element ID": "1.B", "Element Name": "Career Interests"}
{"Description": "Broad types of work you enjoy.", "Element ID": "1.B.1", "Element Name": "Career Interest Types"}

{"Description": "Work involves designing, building, or repairing of equipment, materials, or structures, engaging in physical activity, or working outdoors. Realistic occupations are often associated with engineering, mechanics and electronics, construction, woodworking, transportation, machine operation, agriculture, animal services, physical or manual labor, athletics, or protective services.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.a", "Element Name": "Realistic"}

{"Description": "Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, living organisms, disease or other forms of impairment, or human behavior. Investigative occupations are often associated with physical, life, medical, or social sciences, and can be found in the fields of humanities, mathematics/statistics, information technology, or health care service.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.b", "Element Name": "Investigative"}

{"Description": "Work involves creating original visual artwork, performances, written works, food, or music for a variety of media, or applying artistic principles to the design of various objects and materials. Artistic occupations are often associated with visual arts, applied arts and design, performing arts, music, creative writing, media, or culinary art.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.c", "Element Name": "Artistic"}

{"Description": "Work involves helping, teaching, advising, assisting, or providing service to others. Social occupations are often associated with social, health care, personal service, teaching/education, or religious activities.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.d", "Element Name": "Social"}

{"Description": "Work involves managing, negotiating, marketing, or selling, typically in a business setting, or leading or advising people in political and legal situations. Enterprising occupations are often associated with business initiatives, sales, marketing/advertising, finance, management/administration, professional advising, public speaking, politics, or law.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.e", "Element Name": "Enterprising"}

{"Description": "Work involves following procedures and regulations to organize information or data, typically in a business setting. Conventional occupations are often associated with office work, accounting, mathematics/statistics, information technology, finance, or human resources.", "Element ID": "1.B.1.f", "Element Name": "Conventional"}

{"Description": "Work involves training, practicing, or competing in athletic events, or supporting those participating in athletics through coaching, training, or officiating.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.i", "Element Name": "Athletics"}

{"Description": "Work involves applying science and technology to the design, building, testing, and use of electrical and electronic components, mechanical devices and machines, automotive, marine, and aerospace equipment and vehicles, materials, or structures.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.j", "Element Name": "Engineering"}

{"Description": "Work involves studying and researching non-living objects, materials, and phenomena through scientific disciplines such as physics, chemistry, astronomy, meteorology, or geology.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.k", "Element Name": "Physical Science"}

{"Description": "Work involves studying and researching human behavior, society, politics, and social relationships through scientific disciplines such as psychology, sociology, economics, or political science.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.n", "Element Name": "Social Science"}

{"Description": "Work involves studying and researching aspects of human history, culture, and language through disciplines such as history, philosophy, the language arts, or area/ethnic studies.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.o", "Element Name": "Humanities"}
{"Description": "Work involves developing and applying mathematics and statistical theory and methods.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.p", "Element Name": "Mathematics/Statistics"}
{"Description": "Work involves designing, developing, testing, and maintaining computer software, hardware, networks, and systems.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.q", "Element Name": "Information Technology"}
{"Description": "Work involves creating original visual artwork for a variety of media and purposes using various techniques and software.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.r", "Element Name": "Visual Arts"}
{"Description": "Work involves applying artistic principles to the design and creation of various objects and materials.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.s", "Element Name": "Applied Arts and Design"}

{"Description": "Work involves acting as a performer in dance, comedy, or dramatic productions, choreographing of dance performances, or producing of live or recorded entertainment.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.t", "Element Name": "Performing Arts"}
{"Description": "Work involves conducting, composing, or playing music or singing.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.u", "Element Name": "Music"}

{"Description": "Work involves developing creative written works, such as novels, scripts, song lyrics, poetry, stories, or advertisements.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.v", "Element Name": "Creative Writing"}

{"Description": "Work involves producing, developing, writing, directing, or presenting information through print, radio, television, or digital media.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.w", "Element Name": "Media"}

{"Description": "Work involves preparing, cooking, and presenting food in a distinctive style usually associated with a specific culture or region.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.x", "Element Name": "Culinary Art"}
{"Description": "Work involves teaching through lectures, discussions, and demonstrations in one or more subjects.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.y", "Element Name": "Teaching/Education"}

{"Description": "Work involves providing social services and assistance to improve the well-being and social and psychological functioning of children and adults.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.z", "Element Name": "Social Service"}

{"Description": "Work involves providing health care services to individuals to include the diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases and other forms of illness or impairment.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.aa", "Element Name": "Health Care Service"}

{"Description": "Work involves conducting religious worship, leading a church or other religious group, and offering moral guidance associated with beliefs and practices of a religious faith.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ab", "Element Name": "Religious Activities"}

{"Description": "Work involves providing personal services to individuals in need of non-medical assistance such as helping arrange or plan for travel, meals, or events.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ac", "Element Name": "Personal Service"}

{"Description": "Work involves providing expert advice, coaching, and counseling on topics such as careers, educational opportunities, and educational and professional development.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ad", "Element Name": "Professional Advising"}
{"Description": "Work involves creating strategic plans or taking actions to expand an organization's business or market share.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ae", "Element Name": "Business Initiatives"}
{"Description": "Work involves selling goods or services.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.af", "Element Name": "Sales"}

{"Description": "Work involves promoting or creating a public image for products, services, or organizations to attract interest, engagement, or sales.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ag", "Element Name": "Marketing/Advertising"}

{"Description": "Work involves directing and managing financial activities, such as planning and investments for an individual or organization to generate income.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ah", "Element Name": "Finance"}

{"Description": "Work involves examining, analyzing, and interpreting accounting records for financial statements, or maintaining, auditing, or evaluating records and accounts.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ai", "Element Name": "Accounting"}

{"Description": "Work involves recruiting, selecting, and training job applicants, maintaining employee personnel records, administering compensation and employee-benefit programs, and conducting employee performance reviews.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.aj", "Element Name": "Human Resources"}

{"Description": "Work involves clerical and administrative tasks for an organization such as answering phones, bookkeeping, updating records, scheduling appointments or meetings, and editing of documents and files.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ak", "Element Name": "Office Work"}

{"Description": "Work involves planning, directing, or coordinating the daily operations of an organization, and overseeing personnel, business, or administrative services.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.al", "Element Name": "Management/Administration"}
{"Description": "Work involves speaking before an audience to educate, entertain, or influence the listeners.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.am", "Element Name": "Public Speaking"}
{"Description": "Work involves engaging in political activities to influence government policy.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.an", "Element Name": "Politics"}
{"Description": "Work involves studying and applying legal knowledge.", "Element ID": "1.B.3.ao", "Element Name": "Law"}
{"Description": "Personality tendencies exhibited at work, which can affect how well someone performs a job.", "Element ID": "1.D", "Element Name": "Work Styles"}

{"Description": "A tendency to proactively pursue excellence through setting high standards, engaging in continuous learning, and persisting and adapting in the face of challenges and uncertainty at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1", "Element Name": "Proactive and Growth Oriented"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be inventive, to be imaginative, and to adopt new perspectives on ways to accomplish work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.a", "Element Name": "Innovation"}

{"Description": "A tendency to establish and maintain personally challenging work-related goals, set high work-related standards, and exert high effort toward meeting those goals and standards.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.b", "Element Name": "Achievement Orientation"}

{"Description": "A tendency to seek out and acquire new work-related knowledge and obtain a deep understanding of work-related subjects.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.c", "Element Name": "Intellectual Curiosity"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be comfortable with ambiguity and uncertainty at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.d", "Element Name": "Tolerance for Ambiguity"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be proactive and take on extra responsibilities and tasks that may fall outside of one's required work role.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.e", "Element Name": "Initiative"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be open to and comfortable with change, new experiences, or ideas at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.f", "Element Name": "Adaptability"}
{"Description": "A tendency to believe in one's work-related capabilities and ability to control one's work-related outcomes.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.g", "Element Name": "Self-Confidence"}

{"Description": "A tendency to exhibit determination and resolve to perform or complete tasks in the face of difficult circumstances or obstacles at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.h", "Element Name": "Perseverance"}
{"Description": "A tendency to lead, take charge, offer opinions, and provide direction at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.1.i", "Element Name": "Leadership Orientation"}
{"Description": "A tendency to engage with others in a positive, supportive, selfless, and considerate manner at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.2", "Element Name": "Interpersonally Oriented"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be modest and humble when interacting with others at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.a", "Element Name": "Humility"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be genuine and sincere in interactions with others at work, without concern for personal gain or self-interest.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.b", "Element Name": "Sincerity"}
{"Description": "A tendency to show concern for others and be sensitive to others' needs and feelings at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.c", "Element Name": "Empathy"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be pleasant, helpful, and willing to assist others at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.d", "Element Name": "Cooperation"}
{"Description": "A tendency to exhibit a positive attitude and positive emotions at work, even under difficult circumstances.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.e", "Element Name": "Optimism"}
{"Description": "A tendency to seek out, enjoy, and be energized by social interaction at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.2.f", "Element Name": "Social Orientation"}

{"Description": "A tendency to approach work with careful attention to quality, reliability, and ethical standards while maintaining organized and thorough work practices.", "Element ID": "1.D.3", "Element Name": "Conscientious and Rule Oriented"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be careful, deliberate, and risk-avoidant when making work-related decisions or doing work.", "Element ID": "1.D.3.a", "Element Name": "Cautiousness"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be detail-oriented, organized, and thorough in completing work.", "Element ID": "1.D.3.b", "Element Name": "Attention to Detail"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be reliable, responsible, and consistent in meeting work-related obligations.", "Element ID": "1.D.3.c", "Element Name": "Dependability"}
{"Description": "A tendency to be honest and ethical at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.3.d", "Element Name": "Integrity"}

{"Description": "A tendency to maintain emotional stability and cope effectively in the face of adversity, criticism, or high-pressure situations at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.4", "Element Name": "Emotionally Resilient"}
{"Description": "A tendency to cope and function effectively in stressful situations at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.4.a", "Element Name": "Stress Tolerance"}

{"Description": "A tendency to remain calm and composed and to manage emotions effectively in response to criticism or difficult situations at work.", "Element ID": "1.D.4.b", "Element Name": "Self-Control"}

{"Description": "Skills you need for most jobs such as reading, writing, math, and learning.", "Element ID": "2.A", "Element Name": "Essential Skills"}

{"Description": "Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.", "Element ID": "2.A.1.a", "Element Name": "Reading Comprehension"}

{"Description": "Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.", "Element ID": "2.A.1.c", "Element Name": "Writing"}
{"Description": "Talking to others to convey information effectively.", "Element ID": "2.A.1.d", "Element Name": "Speaking"}
{"Description": "Using mathematics to solve problems.", "Element ID": "2.A.1.e", "Element Name": "Mathematics"}
